details.method: Before reporting asynchronous preparation failure, persist a bound blocked or unknown attempt that all dispatch callbacks and cold recovery honor; release it only through an explicit bounded recovery action with original ownership and currentness checks.
details.when: An editor preparation completion can trigger history saves or deferred dispatch while producer repair tasks remain queued and production configuration is unavailable.
details.counterexample: An in-memory batch flag disappears at restart; a worker transport blocked receipt cannot represent a distinct preparation failure; deleting generated files or rewriting the immutable baseline would hide the cause.
details.trial_plan: Use the real native public-control workflow to provoke preparation baseline mismatch; require one actual request/result, zero worker starts and no automatic repeats after history saves or cold restart. Explicit Continue may attempt once, Stop plus late callback cannot resume, and missing/mutated receipts remain unknown. Verify strict original-assignment repair separately without rebaselining.
